svg.title: YAGNI
svg.desc: Over the same six weeks, one team builds a shard router and 8 shards for 40 customers and 10,000 rows, while the other keeps one Postgres and ships the CSV export customers asked for. Then a report has to fan out to all 8 shards and merge, and a router bug writes a widget to the wrong shard, while the single Postgres answers both in one hop.

g.text: a report fans out to 8 shards

svg.text: Six weeks went to 8 shards for 40 customers. One Postgres was plenty.
